mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.email AS email, u.password AS password, u.nickname AS nickname, u.user_name AS userName, u.birth_date AS birthDateSql, u.gender AS gender, u.profile_image AS profile_image, u.login_type AS login_type, u.status AS status, r.role_code AS roleCode, ur.role_id AS roleId FROM SOCIAL_LOGIN sl JOIN USER u ON u.user_id = sl.user_id LEFT JOIN USER_ROLE ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN ROLE r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE sl.provider = #{provider} AND sl.provider_user_id = #{providerUserId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER ( email, password, nickname, user_name, birth_date, gender, profile_image, login_type, status, is_terms_agreed, is_privacy_agreed, is_marketing_agreed ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{userName}, #{birthDateSql,jdbcType=DATE}, #{gender}, #{profile_image}, #{login_type}, #{status}, #{termsAgreed}, #{privacyAgreed}, #{marketingAgreed} )
